the hybridization of bio-based materials with synthetic ones is an effective strategy to enhance the mechanical properties of biocomposite systems.
the incorporation of synthetic fibers into biocomposites can significantly improve their mechanical properties.

the hybrid biocomposite materials are a new generation of bio-based composites that are prepared by incorporating two or more different reinforcements (natural, synthetic, or bio-based) into a matrix.

the preparation and characterization of hybrid biocomposites and their applications.
the development of hybrid biocomposites with enhanced mechanical properties, water absorption, and flame retardancy.
a review of recent developments and future trends of the hybrid biocomposites in terms of the mechanical properties, water absorption, and flame retardancy.

the hybrid biocomposites can be considered as a promising material in many applications.
the mechanical, water absorption, and burning resistance properties can be enhanced by using hybrid biocomposites.

the mechanical properties of hybrid biocomposites can be improved by selecting suitable materials for hybrid biocomposites, and the properties can be tailored for a particular application by selecting appropriate materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mechanical properties of hybrid biocomposites are improved by using a combination of natural fibers with synthetic ones, and/or using natural fibers with synthetic fibers, or using natural fibers with natural fibers.

the hybridization of natural fibers with synthetic ones is a promising way to improve the mechanical properties, water absorption behavior, and fire retardancy of biocomposites, and the hybrid biocomposites have great potential to replace conventional synthetic composites in various applications.

the hybridization of bio-based matrices and synthetic fibers, or bio-based fibers and synthetic matrices, is a very effective approach for the development of new biocomposites with better mechanical and physical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the hybridization of natural fiber with synthetic ones or bio-based matrix with synthetic one can be an effective approach to improve mechanical properties and reduce water absorption and flammability of the biocomposites.
hybrid biocomposites can provide an alternative solution to the current challenges in the development of bio-based composites.

the selection of materials and their processing conditions play a crucial role in the performance of hybrid composites, and the hybridization of bio-based and synthetic materials offers a promising approach to overcome the shortcomings in the performance of purely bio-based composites.
